Build succeeds. Here's a summary of what was done:

**The core problem & solution:**  
`SignInManager`/`UserManager` need `HttpContext`, which isn't available in Interactive Server (SignalR) mode. The fix uses `[ExcludeFromInteractiveRouting]` on auth pages so they render as **static SSR** — while all other pages stay globally interactive.

**Changes made:**

1. **`csproj`** — Added `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore` and `Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.InMemory` packages

2. **`Data/ApplicationDbContext.cs`** — EF context for Identity with in-memory store

3. **`Program.cs`** — Registered Identity services, EF, auth/authz middleware, cascading auth state

4. **`App.razor`** — Conditionally applies `InteractiveServer` render mode: pages with `[ExcludeFromInteractiveRouting]` get static SSR (so `HttpContext` works), everything else stays interactive

5. **`Components/Pages/Account/Login.razor`** — Static SSR login page with email/password validation, calls `SignInManager.PasswordSignInAsync`, redirects to `/`

6. **`Components/Pages/Account/Register.razor`** — Static SSR register page with validation (email, password, confirm), calls `UserManager.CreateAsync`, redirects to `/account/login`

7. **`Components/Pages/Account/Logout.razor`** — Static SSR page that signs out and redirects to `/`

8. **`MainLayout.razor`** — Shows "Logged in as {email} | Logout" when authenticated, "Login | Register" when not

9. **`_Imports.razor`** — Added auth-related usings
